title: The mocked-timer slow-worker witness cannot detect a wall-clock deadline reintroduced on another wait or in a fixture process
outcome: A regression that puts a wall-clock deadline back into scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs is caught by a test. The deadline could come back on any process wait (a setTimeout race) or in a fixture process (Date.now()). One option is routing waits through one helper whose time is injectable; another is a source guard over the test file and its fixture sources.
acceptance: The mocked-timer slow-worker witness cannot detect a wall-clock deadline reintroduced on another wait or in a fixture process is done
